method: Native Windows UI selection, Ctrl+B / Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, graceful quit and relaunch, inline table edit, task click, title rename, viewer navigation, notebook MD export and directory reimport. Evidence reads use read-only SQLite and exported files; no database or source-file writes perform the measured operations.
settings: Isolated test profile, default Markdown options, built-in plugins only, no synchronisation target configured; default inline Markdown rendering retained; ordinary MD export without front matter

formatting.observation: One outer pair of bold markers spans the blank line and remains literal in the rendered view.

table.observation: Native inline table edit aligns Markdown source whitespace; text outside the table is byte-identical.
